about: provenance of the trimmed fixtures (prep for batch p3-G01-2): source live | research | documented | synthetic; contact values are documentation values (example.org/.net, *.example, +55 11 5555-01xx)

measurements_anomaly_cn.json.note: HTTP 200 in 1.25s; kept the fields the parser reads (scores reduced to blocking_general and analysis.blocking_type); query_time dropped

measurements_ok_id.json.note: measurements?domain=example.com&limit=2 (no probe_cc); minimised like the CN fixture

measurements_empty_br.http.json.note: results [] and next_url null: no BR measurement of the exact host google.com in the default 30-day window (www.google.com has 1318 BR measurements in the same window)

measurements_invalid_cc_empty.json.note: probe_cc=BRA (3 letters) answered HTTP 200 with results [] - indistinguishable from 'no measurements'; the module must validate ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 before sending

measurements_page2_synthetic.json.note: second page whose metadata.next_url is still set; a third page must not be fetched (FC1 cap)

aggregation_ok.json.note: db_stats dropped; 152 anomalies in 23754 measurements (0.6%) = sporadic noise

aggregation_by_country.json.note: 150 rows in the live answer, 7 kept; all probe_cc values seen live: AE AL AM AO AR AT AU AZ BA BD BE BG BH BJ BO BR BY BZ CA CD CH CI CL CM CN CO CR CU CY CZ DE DK DO DZ EC EE EG ES ET FI FR GA GB GE GH GN GP GR GT GY HK HN HR HT HU ID IE IL IN IQ IR IS IT JE JM JO JP KE KG KH KR KZ LB LC LK LR LS LT LU LV LY MA MD ME MG MK ML MM MR MT MU MV MW MX MY MZ NA NC NG NI NL NO NP NZ OM PA PE PH PK PL PR PS PT PY QA RO RS RU RW SA SE SG SI SK SL SN SO SR SV SY TG TH TJ TL TN TR TT TW TZ UA UG US UY UZ VE VN YE ZA ZM ZW

aggregation_empty_synthetic.json.note: a domain OONI never measured from the country: 'no measurements', never 'not blocked'

explorer_challenge_429.http.json.note: explorer.ooni.org answered 429 then 403 (domain page) with x-vercel-mitigated: challenge; the x-vercel-challenge-token and x-vercel-id headers were dropped; body trimmed to the title

rate_limited_429_synthetic.http.json.origin: not observed (x-ratelimit-remaining was 3936-3984 during the checks)
rate_limited_429_synthetic.http.json.note: 429 from the API itself (not a WAF page) -> RATE_LIMITED, could not verify

error_502_html_synthetic.http.json.origin: nginx default error page (api.ooni.io runs nginx/1.18.0)
error_502_html_synthetic.http.json.note: HTML instead of JSON on an error status -> ERROR, could not verify (FC4)
